build_gaussian_smearing: build a GaussianSmearing module to encode atom distances using Gaussian basis functions
build_sigmoid_smearing: build a SigmoidSmearing module to encode atom distances using sigmoid basis functions
build_linear_sigmoid_smearing: build a LinearSigmoidSmearing module to encode atom distances with sigmoid plus linear residual
build_silu_smearing: build a SiLUSmearing module to encode atom distances using a linear layer with SiLU activation
test_smearing_forward: test the forward pass of a smearing module on a tensor of atom distances
